items.name: Potion of Cohesion Healing
items.effect: Restores 1d4 hit points for each creature in your cohesion (minimum of 1d4.)
items.description: A bubbling crimson liquid in a stoppered glass vial.

items.name: Cloak of Sealing Wind
items.effect: You ignore winds and windy forces while wearing this cloak.
items.description: Made of heavy material that is extremely aerodynamic on an atomic level.

items.name: Bottle Bomb
items.effect: When this bottle breaks, each creature within 15ft of it must succeed in a DC 13 dexterity saving throw, receiving 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much on a successful save.

items.name: Potion of First Responders
items.effect: Action to drink: For the next 1 hour, you make your initiative rolls with advantage. If you are in initiative order right now, reroll your initiative order.
items.description: Blue and grimey liquid that seems hard to swallow.

items.name: Spear of Gravity
items.effect:
+1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
Dawnbound: You may expend your action to force each other creature within 15ft of you to make a DC 17 strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature receives 2d6 force damage and is pulled towards you until it cannot be pulled further due to something blocking it, or until it is within 5ft of you. The spear can be used like this once, and it regains the use next dawn.
items.description: It feels almost weightless when actually being wielded, as if it had its own anchor-point in spacetime.

items.name: Tactical Goo
items.effect: As an action you hurl this vial of goo at a position within 30ft of yourself. The vial cracks on impact, and turns that position into difficult terrain.
items.description: It's green and smells bad. It's also extremely viscous.

items.name: Scar of Heresy
items.effect:
As you attune to this item, a massive scar appears across your chest, over your heart.
Heretic: You have resistance against non-physical damage dealt by celestials, and cannot be targeted by spells cast by such creatures if the level of the spell is 3 or lower.
Faithless: You cannot cast spells or use abilities or traits granted to you by faith. Spells and magical effects that deal damage to you, or would grant hit points to you, have their power halved. (If you would gain 4 hit points, you gain 2 hit points instead. If you would receive 8 damage, you receive 4 damage instead.)
items.description: Once knew a paladin who had one of these. He was a terrifying guy.
items.attunement: Attunement by a creature that has lost its faith

items.name: Blightstar
items.effect:
Void Aura: Each creature within15ft of you has their constitution score be equal to the lowest constitution score among them. If the creature with the lowest base constitution score, or a creature tied to the lowest base constitution score doesn't have proficiency in constitution saving throws, all the creatures affected lose the proficiency in that saving throw while under this aura's effect.
Blight Spell: You can cast Blight from this item using your highest mental ability modifier + proficiency bonus + 8 as the DC for the spell, if you are not a spellcaster. You can cast the spell once per day without expending a spell slot, regaining the use when the next time the sun fully sets. Alternatively you may cast the spell using spell slots.
items.description: An eight-pointed star carved from unpolished necrotite.
items.attunement: Attunement by an evil aligned creature

items.name: Goosehorn
items.effect: Conjure Goose: Once per day as an action, this horn can be activated by blowing into it to conjure a goose creature of a CR equal to or less than the carrier's CR or level. It is loyal to none, but can be befriended, and it's always the same goose. The goose cannot be conjured if it died today, or if it's still alive. It is sentient, understands common but speaks in honks, and does not like when it dies. Speak with animals spell can be used to speak with it, and it might understand other languages at DM's discretion.

items.name: Rule of Law
items.effect:
Damage Up: This bow's base damage is increased by 1 of its damage types. (1d6 becomes 2d6, 1d8 becomes 2d8 and so on.)
Creator of Law: When you fire this bow, and if you are a lawful-aligned creature, you may expend your reaction and utter a law that does not specify a creature or a group of creatures. That law becomes a part of reality and cannot be broken until this encounter is over. It touches each and every creature in the initiative order, no matter their alignment or relationship to this item. (You cannot make a rule "Greg cannot cast spells" or "The baddies cannot regain hit points" since those are specific and not universal rules.)
